uebersicht.notfallcode: The emergency access was used on {datum} (account {name}).
uebersicht.notfallcode.text: A new password was set with the emergency code from the emergency sheet, and two-factor sign-in was reset. If this wasn’t you, reset the account’s password, download a new emergency sheet and change the key.
uebersicht.heimnetz-gateway: Ablago can’t tell the home network from the internet.
uebersicht.heimnetz-gateway.text: Requests arrive with the address {adresse}, the gateway address of its own network, with Docker the one of the Docker network (last on {datum}). Ablago doesn’t believe proxy information from there; the requests don’t count as the home network, not for the emergency access either, nor for setup without a code, and they share one address for sign-in protection. If your reverse proxy runs on the same computer, set TRUST_PROXY to {adresse}. Otherwise: a port mapping without the userland proxy or an address of its own for the container (macvlan).
uebersicht.proxy-netz: TRUST_PROXY names a whole network ({netz}) instead of your proxy’s address.
uebersicht.proxy-netz.text: Requests come directly from the gateway {adresse} (last on {datum}), and the network covers it. Enter only your proxy’s address, e.g. {adresse} – a whole network also believes requests that merely come through the gateway.
